name: live-earnings
description: Speaker-attributed earnings call transcripts, live and after the call. Ask who said what on a company's earnings call — each turn is attributed to the executive or analyst who spoke, where they can be identified.

interface.longDescription: Live Earnings gives ChatGPT speaker-attributed transcripts of public company earnings calls — ended calls and calls in progress. Each turn is attributed to the executive or analyst who spoke it, where they can be identified, so you can ask what the CFO said about guidance, who asked about margins, or how management answered a specific analyst. Read-only: it lists calls, a call's roster of executives and analysts, the call's sections, the analysts' Q&A exchanges, and the transcript itself. Independent service; not financial advice. Sign in with a Live Earnings account.
defaultPrompt: Which earnings calls can I ask about?
On NVIDIA's latest call, what did each analyst ask?
